params.name: Note division
params.usage: 0: Whole notes; 1: Half notes; 2: Quarter note triplets; 3: Quarter notes; 4: Eighth notes; 5: Sixteenth notes

params.name: MIDI clock ignore
params.usage: 0: Ignore MIDI clock messages; 127: Listen for MIDI clock messages

params.name: Bypass
params.usage: 0: Bypass pedal; 127: Engage pedal and reset ramping
